description.value: Independent Vancouver Island licensee of National, with branches at Victoria (airport, downtown, Colwood, Sidney), Duncan, Nanaimo (airport and downtown), Comox airport and Courtenay, Campbell River airport, Port Hardy airport, and North Vancouver. Offers one-way rentals between its Island branches with no drop charge — the best one-way option for the North Island. No bike racks for rent; a bike travels inside an SUV or minivan with the seats folded. Confirm one-way availability and vehicle type when booking.
